title: Steering the Wrong Layer x Silent Failure: Layer-Mismatch as a Compound Robustness Hole

original_idea.body: Map the effect-vs-layer curve of a safety vector, identify the silent-failure zone where it runs without error but has near-zero effect, and propose an automated check.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible chain via safety-pipeline sanity-check infra, but layer-dependence is well known; modest catastrophic-risk link.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Apply vector across all layers, map effect curve, add an assertion; very accessible inference-only task.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Single clean experiment: effect-vs-layer curve + silent-failure-zone + simple check.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Small reusable pipeline-safety infra for the open community; public tools, no internal access.

low_compute.reasoning: Inference-only layer sweep on a small model; CPU/single GPU.

novelty.reasoning: Layer-dependence is well documented; the silent-failure-zone + automated-check framing is the partly-open bit.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Layer-dependence is documented; the silent-failure-zone characterization plus automated check may be open.
